$schema_note: Minimum-privilege IAM policy for the DAILY AREA-SIGNALS Fargate task role (`python -m pipeline_area_signals.run`). Attach to the role referenced by `area_signals_task_definition.json.taskRoleArn` (`reciterai-area-signals-task`). Narrower than every other task role on purpose: DynamoDB is scoped by `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` to the three partitions this pipeline touches (the same pinning SPS uses for its SUBMISSION writes): `AREAINPUT` (Query the queue, GetItem to re-read status before spending, UpdateItem to claim an item with a lease and mark it scored/failed), `AREASIGNAL#*` (GetItem for the input-hash reuse check, PutItem the output row), and `STAGE#area_signals#GLOBAL` (PutItem the run ledger row). No Scan, no Delete, no BatchWrite, no index access. NO S3 (the output is DynamoDB rows SPS projects). NO SecretsManager: the three secrets (Bedrock bearer token, OpenAI key for the content-filter fallback, Teams webhook) are injected as env vars by the EXECUTION role. NO `bedrock:InvokeModel`: Bedrock authenticates via `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` (same posture as every other task). CloudWatch Logs scoped to `/ecs/reciterai-area-signals`.
